description_en: This topic describes the syntax and provides examples of the DetectVideoIPCObject operation in the object detection (objectdet) category
description_zh: 本文为您介绍目标检测（objectdet）类目下的IPC视频目标检测DetectVideoIPCObject的语法及示例
name: DetectVideoIPCObject

parameters.help_en: The URL of the video file. We recommend that you use an OSS URL in the Shanghai region. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS bucket outside the Shanghai region, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.help_zh: 视频文件URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.name: video_url

parameters.help_en: The timestamp of the actual start time of the video. For example, if the video starts at 12:00 on August 16, 2021, the corresponding timestamp is 1629086400
parameters.help_zh: 视频实际开始时间的时间戳。例如视频开始时间是2021年8月16日12:00，对应时间戳为1629086400
parameters.name: start_timestamp

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to filter callback messages. Valid values:

- true: The callback is triggered only when objects are detected in the input video.
- false: The callback is triggered regardless of whether objects are detected
parameters.help_zh:
是否回调消息过滤。

- true：如果输入的视频中检测到有目标，才会执行回调，否则不执行。
- false: 无论是否检测到有目标，都执行回调
parameters.name: callback_only_has_object
